tourPackages.title: Achimota Volta Heritage Experience
tourPackages.description: A three-day Volta and Keta heritage experience designed around water, memory, coastline and centenary pride. Participants begin with a warm send-off, enjoy Lake Volta, visit historic landmarks and gather for a memorable resort dinner on the Keta coastline.
highlights: Complimentary Breakfast — Hebs send-off gift for every Tour 3 participant before the journey begins.
Dodi Princess Boat Ride — Five-hour Lake Volta cruise with food, drinks, music, networking and life jackets.
Adomi Bridge — Photo stop at the historic 1957 suspension bridge at Atimpoku.
Fort Prinzenstein, Keta — 1784 Danish fort and former slave trade site.
Keta Flag Planting Ceremony — Symbolic flag planting in Keta on Day 2.
Resort Dinner, Keta — Day 2 evening at Aborigines Beach Resort, informal but memorable.

tourHighlights.title: Adomi Bridge
tourHighlights.description: A crossing and photo stop at the historic 1957 suspension bridge at Atimpoku — one of Ghana's most photographed landmarks on the Volta River.

tourHighlights.title: Dodi Princess Boat Cruise
tourHighlights.description: A scenic 5-hour cruise on Lake Volta to Dodi Island and back. Life jackets provided. Food, drinks, and music on board. An experience unlike anything else on the tour circuit.

inclusions: Daily water: 3 bottles per person per day

itinerary.title: Accra Departure — Adomi Bridge — Dodi Princess Cruise
itinerary.description: Depart Achimota School 6:00 AM with complimentary breakfast provided. Cross the Adomi Bridge at Atimpoku. Board the Dodi Princess at Akosombo for a 5-hour Lake Volta cruise.

activities.activity: Depart Achimota School — complimentary breakfast provided before boarding
Adomi Bridge, Atimpoku — crossing and photo stop
Arrive Akosombo jetty — brief Akosombo Dam viewpoint stop
Board Dodi Princess — depart for Dodi Island
Land at Dodi Island — village walk and cultural exchange
Return cruise to Akosombo (2.5 hrs). Lunch and drinks on board
Arrive back at Akosombo — drive east to overnight stop
Check in and dinner

itinerary.title: Fort Prinzenstein — Keta Flag Planting — Resort Dinner
itinerary.description: Drive to Keta. Guided tour of Fort Prinzenstein. The Achimota flag is planted overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Keta Lagoon sunset walk. Alumni resort dinner on the coastline.

activities.activity: Drive to Keta (1.5 hrs)
Fort Prinzenstein — guided tour of the 1784 Danish fort
Keta Flag Planting Ceremony — Achimota flag planted overlooking the Atlantic
Lunch at a local Keta seafood spot
Check in at Aborigines Beach Resort
Keta Lagoon Sunset Walk — ocean-lagoon peninsula at golden hour
Resort Dinner — alumni dinner at Aborigines Beach Resort on the Keta coastline

itinerary.title: Return to Accra
itinerary.description: Depart Keta after breakfast. Return to Accra via Sogakope. Tour concludes at Achimota School.

activities.activity: Breakfast and check out
Depart Keta — return to Accra via Sogakope (3 hrs)
Arrive Accra — optional Accra city stop
Arrive Achimota School — Volta Heritage Experience concludes

accommodationOptions.label: Reddington Beach Resort, Keta
accommodationOptions.description: Beachfront resort on the Keta coastline — the venue for the alumni resort dinner. Rooms face the Atlantic Ocean with direct beach access. Built on the unique ocean-lagoon peninsula.
accommodationOptions.notes: Beachfront resort on the Keta coastline

tourPackages.pickupNote: All tours depart Achimota School at 6:00 AM on their respective dates and return to Achimota by 10 AM.
tourPackages.route: Achimota → Akosombo → Keta → Return to Achimota

tourPackages.title: Achimota Western and Coastal Legacy Route
tourPackages.description: A four-day western and coastal journey connecting alumni to Ghana's historic coastal memory, symbolic centenary flag planting and Ashanti heritage. This route moves from Cape Coast and Elmina to Wiawso and Kumasi, ending with the combined alumni dinner.
highlights: Assin Manso Slave River Site — Reflection site and final resting point of enslaved Africans before shipment.
Elmina Castle — UNESCO World Heritage site and oldest European building in sub-Saharan Africa.
Wiawso Flag Planting Ceremony — Symbolic flag planting ceremony in Wiawso on Day 2.
Manhyia Palace, Kumasi — Audience and guided tour focused on Ashanti heritage.
Combined Alumni Dinner, Kumasi — Day 3 evening with Tours 1 and 2 at Lancaster Hotel, Kumasi.

tourHighlights.title: Elmina Castle
tourHighlights.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the oldest European buildings in sub-Saharan Africa. Built by the Portuguese in 1482. Guided tour — emotionally significant.

tourHighlights.title: Assin Manso Slave River Site
tourHighlights.description: A deeply moving reflection site on the banks of the Donkor Nsuo river — the final bathing place of enslaved Africans before shipment. One of Ghana's most significant heritage sites.

tourHighlights.title: Wiawso Flag Planting Ceremony
tourHighlights.description: Symbolic Achimota centenary flag planting ceremony in Wiawso on Day 2 — a moment of alumni pride at the heart of the Western Region.

tourHighlights.title: Manhyia Palace, Kumasi
tourHighlights.description: The seat of the Asantehene and the heart of Ashanti royal heritage. Guided palace museum tour on Day 3 before the combined alumni dinner.

inclusions: Daily water: 3 bottles per person per day

itinerary.title: Accra Departure — Assin Manso — Elmina Castle
itinerary.description: Depart Achimota School 6:00 AM. Drive to Assin Manso for a reflection ceremony. Guided tour of Elmina Castle. Overnight Cape Coast.

activities.activity: Depart Achimota School — private AC coach
Assin Manso Slave River Site — guided reflection ceremony
Drive to Elmina (45 min)
Guided tour of Elmina Castle — dungeons and Door of No Return
Drive to Cape Coast — check in
Welcome dinner

itinerary.title: Western North — Wiawso Flag Planting Ceremony
itinerary.description: Drive through the Western North Region to Wiawso. The Achimota flag is planted here with local old students and community witnesses present.

activities.activity: Depart Cape Coast — drive to Western North Region
Arrive Wiawso — welcome by local Achimota old students
Wiawso Flag Planting Ceremony — community witnesses present
Depart for Kumasi (3 hrs)
Arrive Kumasi — check in

itinerary.title: Manhyia Palace — Combined Alumni Dinner, Kumasi
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Manhyia Palace. Evening: grand combined alumni dinner with Tour 1 at Lancaster Hotel, Kumasi.

activities.activity: Manhyia Palace — guided tour of Ashanti royal heritage
Kumasi Cultural Centre and Kejetia Market (optional)
Rest and prepare for dinner
Combined Alumni Dinner — Tours 1 & 2 together at Lancaster Hotel

itinerary.title: Return to Accra
itinerary.description: Depart Kumasi after breakfast. Return to Accra by afternoon.

activities.activity: Breakfast and check out
Depart Kumasi — return to Accra (5 hrs)
Arrive Achimota School — tour concludes

accommodationOptions.label: Lancaster Hotel, Kumasi
accommodationOptions.description: The venue for the grand combined alumni dinner. Central Kumasi location, full-service hotel with restaurant, conference facilities, and comfortable en-suite rooms.

tourPackages.pickupNote: All tours depart Achimota School at 6:00 AM on their respective dates and return to Achimota by 10 AM.
tourPackages.route: Achimota → Cape Coast → Wiawso → Kumasi → Achimota
